title: A migration from a monolith to microservices is failing. What do you do?
description: Apply the strangler fig pattern, add observability, and migrate incrementally by domain.

data.text: **Question:** A migration from a monolith to microservices is failing. What do you do?

Stop big-bang cuts. Use the strangler fig pattern to incrementally route traffic to new services. Add observability, define service boundaries by domain, and fix data consistency with anti-corruption layers.

items: Strangler fig: intercept requests and gradually replace monolith paths
Add distributed tracing and structured logging
Use anti-corruption layers to translate legacy models
Defer database splitting until services are stable
Splitting by layer instead of domain
How do you handle distributed transactions?
When should you split the database?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Migrate incrementally, not all at once
data.takeaway: Migrate incrementally, not all at once
